name: SmartCiti.X Holodeck

dialogue: First day on the deck? Watch the crane, mind your tie-off, and ask before you lift.
The Ironworkers hall runs the steel. Earn the lift and the crew has your back.
The iron spark is at the Ironworkers hall. Collect it, walk the Structural District, and come back with the circuit done.
The Crane Operators run the lift and the Riggers & Signalpersons run the calls. Steel moves when all three agree.
The Load Chart Judgment sim is where a good lift is decided before the hook ever moves. Go and judge one.
npcs.name: Ironworkers Foreman

dialogue: A clean bead starts before the arc — clean metal, steady hand, right heat.
Run the sim bay first. The bead never lies, but the sim lets you try again.
The weld relic is by the Welding Trades hall. Collect it, then run the Weld Bead Run sim and show me a clean bead.
The Boilermakers next door weld pressure; we weld structure. Same fire, different promises.
Bring the bead back to the Ironworkers Foreman when the circuit calls for it. A clean bead is a structural promise.
npcs.name: Welding Instructor

dialogue: Every lift is a conversation between the operator and the signalperson.
Learn the signals cold. On this deck, a missed signal is a missed lift.
The crane spark is at the Tower Crane Lift sim. Collect it, stand in the sim bay, and run your first supervised lift.
The Riggers & Signalpersons Lead calls the lift; I run the crane. One voice, one hook, no surprises.
The Load Chart Data is by the rigging bay. Read it before you lift — the chart is the lift, the crane is just the muscle.
npcs.name: Crane Operator Lead

dialogue: Rigging is trust you can measure — check the sling, check the angle, check again.
Signal clear and the load moves. Signal sloppy and nothing moves at all.
The rigging spark is by the Riggers & Signalpersons hall. Collect it, then stand in the Tower Crane Lift sim with the Crane Operator Lead.
The Rigging Signal Call sim is where the calls are learned. A wrong call is worse than a slow lift.
The Scaffold Bay Build sim is where the lift starts — no scaffold, no lift. Check it before the crane moves.
npcs.name: Riggers & Signalpersons Lead

quests.description: Learn the crane signals and complete your first supervised lift.

steps.text: Talk to the Crane Operator Lead

Report back to the Crane Operator Lead

sources: Anchor: lat 39.84645175015757, lon -86.621608018757 (Indianapolis / SmartCiti.X Holodeck anchor). Status anchored = real-world anchor coordinate exists; rp1 null, NOT live on RP1.
Fabric: 131 nodes total (scene root + 19 top-level + 111 nested); 124 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts = the 8 real top-level '* District' nodes. Buildings = all 111 real hall nodes (12 Structural District halls + 21 Envelope & Finish + 18 Building Systems + 17 Energy & Utilities + 12 Earthworks & Plant + 10 Heavy Industry + 10 Transport & Mobility + 11 Survey, Safety & Environment) + the 11 real 'Sim · ...' nodes. Hall positions are the fabric node's own position through the world's fabric_transform (scale 0.15), exactly as Phase 1 did for the Structural halls — so halls from different districts share the same central plan grid and may overlap in-world; the fabric gives no separate per-district offset. Every hall model is unhosted — labelled procedural placeholder shown.
NPCs: the Holodeck fabric has no 'Agent · ...' nodes; NPC roles are named after real fabric hall nodes and all dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'city' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
